# Casa Del Puente

Heritage whole-house vacation rental in Boquete, Chiriqui, Panama.

## Facts

- URL: https://casadelpuente.site
- Type: exclusive-use heritage home (not per-room booking)
- Location: Boquete, Panama (Flower Capital), 8-minute walk to town center
- Coordinates: 8.78345, -82.42905
- Bedrooms: 4 botanically named rooms — Geisha, Orquidea, Hortensia, Veranera
- Sleeps: up to 10 guests
- Rate: USD 550 per night, minimum 2 nights
- Booking: WhatsApp +507 6416-0902
- Email: info@casadelpuente.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/casadelpuente_bqt
- TikTok: https://tiktok.com/@casadelpuentepanama
- Stewardship: four generations of family hospitality since 1920
